metadata.document_title: R3 System Test Specification for foxBMS BMS

SG-BMS-002.description: Prevention of overcharge and overdischarge conditions
SG-BMS-002.safe_state: Charge/discharge current limited to zero, contactors open

SG-BMS-003.safe_state: Current limited, contactors opened if threshold exceeded

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify cell overtemperature detection triggers safe state transition within FTTI
preconditions: AFE measurement cycle running at 10ms intervals
test_steps: Inject cell temperature reading above BC_TEMPERATURE_MAX_DISCHARGE_MSL_ddegC threshold
Start timing measurement at injection point
Verify BMS state machine transition to ERROR state
Verify all contactor feedback indicates OPEN state
expected_results: SPS channels for contactors show CONT_SWITCH_OFF state
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Total response time from temperature exceedance to contactors open < 500ms

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify cell undervoltage during discharge triggers thermal protection
test_steps: Inject cell voltage below BC_VOLTAGE_MIN_MSL_mV threshold
Verify diagnostic module reports cell undervoltage
Verify SOF module sets discharge current limit to zero
Verify BMS initiates safe state transition
expected_results: AFE_PLAUS_002 validation fails for injected cell
SOF discharge current limit set to 0mA within 100ms
BMS transitions to ERROR state if undervoltage persists
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Discharge current limitation active within 100ms of detection

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify AFE communication failure detection and safe state entry
test_steps: Inject CRC error in AFE communication (corrupt isoSPI response)
Verify command counter mismatch detection per AFE-ADI-015
Verify measurement data marked as invalid
expected_results: CRC error counter incremented for affected IC
BMS marks string measurement data as invalid
Contactor opening initiated if error persists > 3 cycles
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Communication failure detected within single measurement cycle (10ms)

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify open wire detection triggers safe state for affected string
preconditions: Open wire check period elapsed (30000ms per AFE-API-008)
test_steps: Simulate open wire condition on cell voltage sense line
Monitor AFE-ADI-023 open wire detection with 470 Ohm pull-up
Verify diagnostic entry for open wire
Verify string isolation or system safe state
expected_results: Open wire detected via voltage comparison with pull-up active
If multiple strings affected, BMS transitions to ERROR
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Open wire fault detected and string isolated within 2 measurement cycles

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify SBC watchdog failure triggers system safe state
test_steps: Monitor watchdog window timeout (128ms per SBC-022)
Verify FS0B assertion when counter reaches limit (8)
Verify MCU reset via RSTB if configured (SBC-027)
expected_results: Watchdog timeout detected by FS85 SBC
Fault error counter increments per bad refresh
FS0B asserts low after 8 bad watchdog events
System enters safe state with contactors open
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Safe state achieved within 8 x 128ms = 1024ms of watchdog failure

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify redundant ADC measurement comparison detects stuck values
test_steps: Inject stuck voltage value to C-ADC measurement
Trigger voltage register read and comparison
Verify stuck register detection per AFE-ADI-017
expected_results: C-ADC vs S-ADC comparison exceeds threshold
Stuck voltage register detected (0x8000 per AFE-ADI-028)
Diagnostic entry created for measurement failure
Cell voltage marked as invalid (INT16_MAX per AFE-API-009)
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Stuck value detected within single measurement cycle

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify temperature plausibility check rejects out-of-range values
test_steps: Inject GPIO voltage outside valid NTC range
Monitor diagnostic entry for implausible temperature
expected_results: Diagnostic entry for temperature sensor failure
Measurement marked invalid, BMS uses redundant data
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Implausible temperature rejected within measurement cycle

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify interlock feedback triggers contactor opening
expected_results: Interlock feedback change detected within 1ms cycle
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Safe state achieved within 500ms of interlock opening

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify AFE supply voltage monitoring detects out-of-range conditions
preconditions: Supply voltage monitoring enabled per AFE-ADI-006, AFE-ADI-007
test_steps: Inject analog supply (VA) voltage outside 4512mV-5486mV range
Verify diagnostic entry for supply fault
expected_results: VA out-of-range detected per AFE-ADI-007 limits
Diagnostic flag set for AFE supply fault
BMS enters degraded mode or safe state
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Supply voltage fault detected within diagnostic cycle (10 iterations per AFE-MXM-002)

SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.description: Verify algorithm blocking on execution time violation
test_steps: Inject delay in algorithm calculation function
Monitor algorithm state transition to BLOCKED
Verify diagnostic entry for algorithm timeout
Verify BMS handles missing state estimation data
expected_results: Algorithm execution time monitored per ALGO-MGR-003
Algorithm marked BLOCKED when duration exceeded
Diagnostic entry created for algorithm failure
BMS uses last valid SOC/SOE values
SG-BMS-001_thermal_runaway_prevention.pass_criteria: Algorithm blocked and BMS continues operation with degraded accuracy

SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.description: Verify cell overvoltage during charge triggers current limitation
test_steps: Inject cell voltage above BC_VOLTAGE_MAX_RSL_mV threshold
Monitor SOF voltage-based current limit calculation
Verify charge current limit reduction per ALGO-SOF-007
Verify SOF pack current limits set to zero at MSL
expected_results: Cell overvoltage detected within AFE measurement cycle
SOF calculates reduced charge current limit
Charge current limited to zero at MSL threshold
CAN message reports updated current limits
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: Charge current limitation active within 100ms of overvoltage detection

SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.description: Verify SOC limits prevent overcharge at 100%
test_steps: Continue charging until SOC reaches MAXIMUM_SOC_perc
Verify charge current limit approaches zero at 100% SOC
expected_results: SOF reduces charge current as SOC approaches 100%
CAN message indicates fully charged state
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: No overcharge beyond 100% SOC, charge current zero at full SOC

SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.description: Verify cell undervoltage triggers discharge current cutoff
test_steps: Continue discharging until cell voltage approaches BC_VOLTAGE_MIN_RSL_mV
Verify discharge current cutoff at MSL voltage
expected_results: SOF discharge current limit reduced at RSL
Discharge current set to zero at MSL
BMS remains operational but blocks discharge
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: Discharge blocked at undervoltage threshold, no deep discharge

preconditions: BMS in STANDBY or CHARGE state
test_steps: Inject cell temperature below charge cutoff temperature
Verify charge current set to zero
expected_results: Low temperature detected below cutoff threshold
SOF charge current limit calculated as zero
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: Charge blocked at low temperature, no lithium plating risk

SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.description: Verify SOC recalibration at rest prevents drift errors
test_steps: Allow battery to reach rest state
Trigger SOC recalibration via voltage lookup (ALGO-SOC-007)
Compare recalibrated SOC with coulomb-counted value
expected_results: Voltage-based SOC calculated from lookup table
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: SOC recalibration reduces accumulated drift, improves overcharge/overdischarge protection accuracy

test_steps: Inject cell temperature above charge cutoff temperature
Verify charge current zero at MSL temperature
expected_results: High temperature detected above cutoff threshold
Charge current set to zero at MSL temperature
Diagnostic entry for high temperature if persists
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: Charge current limited proportionally to temperature, thermal protection maintained

SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.description: Verify contactor opening on persistent overvoltage
test_steps: Inject persistent cell overvoltage above MSL
Verify BMS transitions to ERROR state
expected_results: Charge current set to zero by SOF
BMS transitions to ERROR after delay (FBMS-SWE-BMS-007)
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: Battery isolated within 1000ms FTTI on persistent overvoltage

SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.description: Verify deep discharge protection via FRAM flag persistence
preconditions: Battery voltage approaching deep discharge threshold
test_steps: Allow battery to discharge to deep discharge threshold
Verify deep discharge flag set in FRAM (DRV-FRAM-006)
Verify BMS reads deep discharge flag on startup
Verify restricted operation until battery recharged
SG-BMS-002_overcharge_overdischarge_prev.pass_criteria: Deep discharge protection persists across power cycles

SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.description: Verify current limitation check triggers safe state on violation
test_steps: Verify BMS response to current violation
Verify current sensor CAN message reception
Verify BMS handles missing current sensor gracefully
Verify degraded mode operation without sensor
expected_results: Current sensor presence flag correctly set
BMS uses current sensor data when present
BMS enters degraded mode if sensor missing
Diagnostic entry for missing current sensor
SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.pass_criteria: Current sensor presence correctly detected, degraded mode active if missing

SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.description: Verify limp home current mode on low temperature discharge
test_steps: Inject cell temperature in limp home range
Monitor SOF discharge current limit calculation
Verify limp home current limit applied (ALGO-SOF-008)
expected_results: Temperature in limp home range detected
Full discharge restored when temperature rises
SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.pass_criteria: Limp home current correctly applied in cold conditions

SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.description: Verify pack current limits calculated from string minimums
test_steps: Configure different voltage/temperature conditions per string
Monitor SOF per-string current limit calculation
Verify pack current = sum of string minimums (ALGO-SOF-015)
Verify weakest cell limits pack current
expected_results: Pack current limit is sum of string minimums
Weakest cell in any string limits pack
CAN reports correct pack current limits
SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.pass_criteria: Pack current correctly limited by weakest cell across all strings

SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.description: Verify moving average current calculation for overcurrent detection
test_steps: Apply varying current over time windows (1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 60s per ALGO-MA-001)
Verify overcurrent based on averaged current
expected_results: Moving average calculated over all time windows
Averaged current used for protection decisions
Transient spikes filtered, sustained overcurrent detected
SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.pass_criteria: Moving average correctly filters transients while detecting sustained overcurrent

SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.description: Verify zero current limits during ERROR state transition
test_steps: Trigger fault condition causing ERROR transition
Monitor SOF pack current limits during transition (ALGO-SOF-014)
Verify all current limits set to zero
Verify CAN reports zero current limits
expected_results: ERROR transition detected by SOF module
All pack current limits set to 0mA
CAN message indicates zero current limits
SG-BMS-003_overcurrent_detection.pass_criteria: All current limits zero during ERROR transition, immediate load shedding

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify normal operation cycle: cell measurement to SOC calculation to state update
preconditions: BMS initialized and in STANDBY state
test_steps: Trigger AFE measurement cycle (AFE_TriggerIc per AFE-API-001)
Verify cell voltage measurement from AFE
Verify state estimation written to database (ALGO-SE-004)
expected_results: SOC/SOE/SOF calculated within algorithm cycle (100ms per ALGO-CFG-001)
BMS state correctly reflects battery status

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify complete precharge sequence from STANDBY to NORMAL
expected_results: Minus contactor closes with feedback verification
Voltage rises to within threshold of string voltage
Precharge contactor opens after voltage equalization
Plus contactor closes, full power path established
end_to_end_functional_tests.pass_criteria: Complete precharge sequence executes with correct contactor sequence and voltage verification

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify cell balancing operation for voltage equalization
preconditions: BMS in NORMAL or CHARGE state
test_steps: Detect cell voltage imbalance across string
Verify balancing current applied to high cells
Verify balancing stops when threshold reached
expected_results: Cell imbalance detected from AFE measurements
Balancing MOSFETs activated on slave modules
Cell voltages converge over balancing period
end_to_end_functional_tests.pass_criteria: Cell voltages equalized within configured threshold

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify error detection to contactor open sequence
expected_results: Fatal error detected within 10ms BMS cycle
Contactors open in correct sequence per current flow
Plus contactor opens first if discharging
All contactors confirmed open via feedback

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify BMS trigger function periodic execution at 10ms
test_steps: Verify state machine execution each cycle
expected_results: No timing violations over extended period
end_to_end_functional_tests.pass_criteria: BMS trigger maintains 10ms period with < 10% jitter

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify CAN message transmission cycle times
test_steps: Verify message cycle times per configuration
expected_results: CAN messages transmitted per configured periods
State messages reflect current BMS state
end_to_end_functional_tests.pass_criteria: All CAN messages transmitted within configured cycle times

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify state request processing and validation
test_steps: Submit valid state request via BMS_SetStateRequest (FBMS-SWE-BMS-045)
Verify request transfer to state machine (FBMS-SWE-BMS-003)
expected_results: Request validated as legal for current state
end_to_end_functional_tests.pass_criteria: Valid state requests processed within 1 BMS cycle

end_to_end_functional_tests.description: Verify FRAM data persistence across power cycles
preconditions: BMS operational with valid SOC/SOE values
test_steps: Verify recovered SOC/SOE values match pre-power-cycle
expected_results: SOC/SOE values written to FRAM with CRC
end_to_end_functional_tests.pass_criteria: All critical data persisted and recovered across power cycle

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify AFE communication chain: MCU to SPI to isoSPI to AFE ICs
test_steps: Send wakeup command to AFE via isoSPI (AFE-ADI-011)
Parse voltage values using conversion formula (AFE-ADI-027)
expected_results: SPI interface operational on correct SPI port
Command transmitted to all ICs in chain
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: Complete AFE communication chain functional with CRC validation

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify SBC watchdog verification and safety path
preconditions: FS85 initialized with safety path check complete (SBC-034, SBC-035)
expected_results: Frame format: CRC, Data LSB, Data MSB, Address/Command
CRC validated on all received frames
Watchdog refreshed within window (128ms per SBC-022)
FS0B release successful in non-debug mode
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: Complete SBC safety path verified and operational

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify contactor control sequence: SPS to contactor to feedback
expected_results: Coil current measured via SPS current sense
Current exceeds ON threshold (20mA per DRV-SPS-009)
No diagnostic entry for feedback mismatch
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: Complete contactor close sequence with feedback verification

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify CAN communication: message cycle and error handling
expected_results: 32 TX and 32 RX message boxes available
RX messages buffered in interrupt handler
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: CAN communication operational with error recovery

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify I2C communication with RTC and humidity sensor
expected_results: RTC time read successfully at address 0x53
Timeout error handled gracefully if occurs
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: I2C peripherals accessible with correct data

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify ADC measurement chain for analog inputs
test_steps: Verify voltage reference (5000mV high, 0mV low per DRV-ADC-004, DRV-ADC-005)
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: ADC measurements accurate within specified tolerance

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify port expander control for auxiliary I/O
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: Port expander I/O control functional via I2C

hw_sw_integration_tests.description: Verify interlock circuit sensing and control
expected_results: Interlock high-side driver enabled at pin 30
hw_sw_integration_tests.pass_criteria: Interlock sensing accurate with correct diagnostic reporting

expected_results: Task starts within 50us of scheduled time
RTC system time increments each ms
SBC trigger executes within same cycle
SPS control executes within same cycle

system_performance_tests.pass_criteria: 100ms algorithm cycle completed within timing budget

system_performance_tests.description: Verify stack usage across all tasks
Verify CPU load under normal operation
system_performance_tests.pass_criteria: CPU load maintains > 10% margin in all modes

system_performance_tests.description: Verify worst-case execution time for safety-critical functions
test_steps: Measure BMS state machine cycle time
system_performance_tests.pass_criteria: All safety-critical WCETs within FTTI timing budget

system_performance_tests.description: Verify SPI/DMA transfer timing for AFE communication
test_steps: Measure total AFE read cycle time
expected_results: AFE read cycle < 5ms for full daisy chain
system_performance_tests.pass_criteria: AFE communication completes within timing constraints

test_steps: Test across range of delay values
system_performance_tests.pass_criteria: MCU timing functions accurate within specified tolerance

test_execution.mode: System integration test on target hardware
